course.title: Frontend Development with React
course.description: Build accessible, component-based interfaces with React and TypeScript. The course runs across five modules with weekly workshops, two hand-ins and a final project reviewed in pairs.

currentModule.title: Hooks & Context
currentModule.description: Dive into React hooks and context API for state management and side effects.

modules.title: Components & props
modules.description: Learn how to create and use React components effectively, including props and state management.

modules.title: State & Lifecycle
modules.description: Understand how to manage state and lifecycle methods in React components.

modules.title: Hooks & Context
modules.description: Dive into React hooks and context API for state management and side effects.

modules.title: Advanced Patterns
modules.description: Explore advanced React patterns for building scalable and maintainable applications.

modules.title: Testing & Debugging
modules.description: Learn how to test and debug React applications effectively.
